# Juno, the shooter, in posable parts (game bones body, head, arm0, arm1). Built facing -Y; the camera
# sees her back. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Shoe --base-color 0.9451 0.9451 0.9176 --no-slot
material new Skin --base-color 0.5529 0.3216 0.2588 --no-slot
material new Shorts --base-color 0.1216 0.3804 0.2627 --no-slot
material new Jersey --base-color 0.2784 0.6431 0.3020 --no-slot
material new Number --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Hair --base-color 0.1608 0.1529 0.1961 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 0.8039 0.2392 0.2392 --no-slot
material new Wrist --base-color 0.9255 0.8353 0.4275 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name ShoeL --size 1 --location -0.1100 -0.0500 0.0650
scale 0.1500 0.3000 0.1300
apply --scale
material assign Shoe
add mesh cube --name LegL --size 1 --location -0.1100 0.0000 0.3200
scale 0.1400 0.1400 0.4000
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name ShoeR --size 1 --location 0.1100 -0.0500 0.0650
scale 0.1500 0.3000 0.1300
apply --scale
material assign Shoe
add mesh cube --name LegR --size 1 --location 0.1100 0.0000 0.3200
scale 0.1400 0.1400 0.4000
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name Shorts --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0000 0.6400
scale 0.4600 0.2800 0.3200
apply --scale
material assign Shorts
add mesh cube --name Jersey --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0000 1.0400
scale 0.4800 0.2800 0.5200
apply --scale
material assign Jersey
active Jersey
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
uv project-from-view back --scale-to-bounds
material assign Number
mode object
material texture Number base-color textures/jersey.png
add mesh cube --name Neck --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0000 1.3300
scale 0.1400 0.1200 0.1000
apply --scale
material assign Skin
select ShoeL ShoeR LegL LegR Shorts Jersey Neck
active Jersey
join
rename Jersey Body
select Body
shade flat
export body.glb --selection
add mesh ico-sphere --name Head --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.16 --location 0 0 0.17
material assign Skin
add mesh ico-sphere --name Hair --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.155 --location 0 0.035 0.21
scale 1.06 1 0.95
apply --scale
material assign Hair
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bun --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.085 --location 0 0.06 0.38
material assign Hair
add mesh cylinder --name Band --vertices 10 --radius 0.168 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0.005 0.22
material assign Band
select Head Hair Bun Band
active Head
join
select Head
shade flat
export head.glb --selection
add mesh cube --name Arm --size 1 --location 0 0 -0.25
scale 0.11 0.11 0.5
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name Wrist --size 1 --location 0 0 -0.46
scale 0.125 0.125 0.07
apply --scale
material assign Wrist
add mesh cube --name Hand --size 1 --location 0 0 -0.56
scale 0.12 0.13 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Skin
select Arm Wrist Hand
active Arm
join
select Arm
shade flat
export arm.glb --selection
